edits.after: Two-plus items favour Sivir because On the Hunt, Ricochet cleave, and utility scale into teamfights far past Lucian's fall-off.

edits.before: The Culling (R) gives Lucian a huge burst window when paired with support CC; your On the Rift (R) helps you disengage, but with an equal-level Lucian holding E and combo up, you're reacting rather than dictating, so respect his all-in threat around the wave.
edits.after: The Culling (R) gives Lucian a huge burst window when paired with support CC; your On the Hunt (R) helps you disengage, but with an equal-level Lucian holding E and combo up, you're reacting rather than dictating, so respect his all-in threat around the wave.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Spell Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit (E): 16s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5 — lock him down while it's on cooldown. - Guard E Spell Shield for his Q or engage. - R The Culling is 110s early — punish before he has it twice.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Lucian's E resets on Lightslinger hits — bait the double-shot proc before he dashes away.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: His Relentless Pursuit dash punishes overextension hard — check flanks before you push past his ward line.
Lightslinger sustain (P) lets him out-heal chip damage on longer fights — Grievous Wounds timing matters more than raw damage.
Read the auto-reset, not the cast
Lucian's combo opens with a Lightslinger auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back, before any spell fires.
